messages:
frank: quick triage: we need to finalize customer comms and enterprise sharing for the inference outage. two asks: (1) 72h customer note, (2) an enterprise appendix option for customers asking for more detail. who owns what?
nina: I can draft the 72h note. Keep it high level: impact, mitigation, what we're doing next. target +48h.
eva: I'll own the enterprise appendix concept and the controlled deep-dive workflow. Legal, can you confirm constraints?
legal-bot: Rules: public notes must not include PII, raw traces, vendor auth tokens, or hostnames. For enterprise appendix: require a support ticket + legal review; prefer redacted PDFs or secure share links. NDA recommended for full raw RCA.
richard: For the appendix, propose two tiers: 
- Tier A: redacted RCA + timeline + mitigation plan (no raw logs)
- Tier B: full RCA + logs in a secure environment (NDA + legal approval)
This lets enterprise customers choose level of detail.
frank: good idea. also need to decide on SLA-credit language. do we offer a credit statement in 72h note or in follow-up? legal?
legal-bot: Don't promise credits in public copy. If SLA credit is applicable, handle via billing/support after internal review. Include a sentence: "Customers affected may contact support for account-specific impact review."
nina: acknowledged. draft timeline snippet for public copy: 
```
We experienced increased request latency for a subset of inference requests between 2026-11-02 02:08-02:42 UTC. The issue has been mitigated and normal service has resumed. We are investigating root cause and will share a follow-up.
```
eva: For the enterprise appendix, I'll prepare a template with: summary, timeline (redacted), root cause (summary-level), mitigations, and a section "How to request more detail" with steps and required approvals.
frank: add recurring-pattern note: platform flagged similar autoscaling regressions 2x in last 45 days. tag incident with "recurring-pattern" and ask platform-eng for a mitigation roadmap. do not include pattern in public text unless legal okays.
nina: ACTIONS I'll create in tracker: 
- ACTION-9001: Draft 72h public note (nina) - due +48h
- ACTION-9002: Prepare enterprise appendix template (eva) - due +72h
- ACTION-9003: Legal review of appendix and redaction rules (legal-bot) - due within 24h of submission
- ACTION-9004: Platform recurring-pattern memo (frank + platform-eng) - due +3d
- ACTION-9005: Verification plan & 7d metrics check (sre/infra) - due +7d
richard: For the appendix template, include a short FAQ for customers about data exposure and contact steps. also include a checkbox list for what we will redact.
eva: sample redaction checklist I'll include: remove IPs/hostnames, mask customer IDs, redact exact timestamps for single-customer events (show ranges), strip stack traces and tokens.
nina: public wording tweak: replace "increased request latency" with "short-term service impact"? less technical.
frank: go with "short-term service impact" for public; keep "increased latency" in appendix/internal RCA.
eva: last item: who coordinates scheduling the enterprise deep-dive calls? propose support+w/eng+legal loop; owner: eva to coordinate initial outreach.
frank: agreed. final: I'll consolidate drafts into the postmortem doc and assign reviewers. please update tracker when you start any ACTION. comms-bot: Postmortem page: https://redwood/pms/1930032100 (editable) :thumbsup:
